title: Vikings to hire Seahawks executive Nolan Teasley as next GM, per report

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vikings to hire Seahawks executive Nolan Teasley as next GM, per report
sources.description: The Vikings have chosen their replacement for Kwesi Adofo-Mensah, as they are reportedly hiring Seahawks assistant GM Nolan Teasley to be their GM.
